observed.stdout:
usage: niri_widths.py [-h] [--check-session] [--opening-width OPENING_WIDTH]

Relax advisory X11 minimum widths only for ordinary Niri tiled windows. New
constrained windows receive one proportional opening-width correction. Later
geometry, application zoom, maximum sizes and height hints stay intact. The
observer starts only from main(), never when imported.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --check-session
  --opening-width OPENING_WIDTH
                        Initial width percentage for newly constrained tiled
                        X11 windows
